verdict.rationale: gstack ships several skill-related mechanisms — `skillify` codifies discovered browser actions into reusable per-site skills (gstack-docs-9), domain-skills are auto-saved and can be promoted from per-project to global (gstack-docs-10, gstack-docs-11, gstack-docs-26), and `learn` lets you review/search/prune/export learned material (gstack-docs-8) — but there's no evidence of a single generic meta-skill that guides writing, iterating, and packaging *arbitrary* new skills end-to-end the way a dedicated skill-authoring tool would. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose 'create/improve/package a skill' workflow or CLI beyond the browser-specific skillify flow, and independent/community confirmation of this authoring loop.
